title: Great app with one suggestion
body:
I absolutely love Google Calendar! It has become one of the main tools I use every day to stay organized, productive, and disciplined. The integration with Google Tasks is excellent, and it has really helped me build better daily habits.

I do have one suggestion that would improve the experience on iPhone.

When I mark a task as completed, a confirmation pop-up with an Undo button appears at the bottom of the screen. While I appreciate having the option to undo, the pop-up blocks the area where I need to tap to complete the next task. This interrupts my workflow because I have to wait for the pop-up to disappear or tap it before I can continue.

It would be much smoother if the confirmation appeared at the top of the screen or in another location that doesn’t interfere with the next task. Right now, it’s easy to accidentally tap Undo, which means I have to manually complete the task again.

This is a small usability improvement, but it would make completing multiple tasks much faster and more seamless.

Thank you to the Google Calendar team for creating such a fantastic app. It has genuinely helped me stay disciplined and organized, and I look forward to future updates!

title: No natural language & wrong Calendar names
body:
I have always used Google Calendar but on my mobile & tablet, I use Fantastical as the “skin” in which to view my calendars. I thought I’d try out the Google Calendar app because it has a timeline in Day to up to Week view, which Fantastical lacks. I really like the Google Calendar app’s interface and UX, but coming from Fantastical, the former seriously falls short:

1) No natural language when writing an event: this is also why I dislike using Google Calendar’s web version, and why I only use it to view events (because lack of desktop app...PLEASE MAKE ONE!) I’m surprised that an app from a pioneer like Google would be missing a feature that some other relatively younger companies have been able to implement for years.

2) Some Calendar names do not match to the name that is given by me. For example, I have an “Academics” calendar which shows up as just “Events” in the app. And there’s nothing I can do in the app to change or modify it. I also reinstalled the app to see if this could be fixed—it isn’t.

3) No today’s Date shown on the app badge or app icon. If it’s a calendar app, it should definitely have something to indicate today’s date.

4) app Widget doesn’t show a Monthly calendar view; it only shows events. I’d like to quickly view the Month and see (via coloured dots that correspond to calendars’ chosen colour) the days on which I have events. 

Things I do like:
1) Very customisable but simple-to-add Notifications
2) Very customisable Repeating function
3) As stated before, a timeline in certain views
4) Event Illustrations are smart and really pleasant

For now, the shortcomings outweigh the positives so I will not be using this app.
